semiconductor_relevance: High — JET Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in optical inspection and testing equipment for circuit boards, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JET Technology Co., Ltd. provides advanced optical inspection and testing solutions for circuit boards, including high-precision 3D solder paste inspection machines and in-circuit testers. Their equipment is designed to ensure quality control throughout the manufacturing process, making them a key player in the semiconductor testing segment.

regional_presence.Taiwan: JET Technology is the first manufacturer in Taiwan to develop an in-circuit tester for circuit boards.
